en: Colorized historic postcard view of a European street scene at sunset or early evening. On the left stands a red-brick church or chapel with a tall, slender spire and a steep tiled roof, partly surrounded by trees. On the right are several multi‑story bourgeois townhouses with shops at street level and pedestrians walking along the curved street. The sky fades from orange near the horizon to light blue at the top. At the top center of the image is printed text indicating the city and street.
